extracted.intended_audience: Researchers and research organisations applying for Medical Research Council (MRC) / UKRI funding
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and eligibility/requirement statements for specific MRC/UKRI funding opportunities (e.g., Experimental Medicine stage one; UKRI metascience scientometrics). Covers required scope, applicant organisational eligibility, invitation status, funding coverage, and timing/deadlines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Intervention in humans required (Experimental medicine stage one)
rubrics_metrics.description: Your application must include an intervention in humans.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply for funding to investigate the causes, progression and treatment of human disease. This requirement is explicitly stated as part of the Experimental medicine stage one opportunity (publication date 30 April 2026; opening date 30 April 2026 9:00am UK time; closing date 7 October 2026 4:00pm UK time).

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant organisational eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: You must be a researcher based at a research organisation eligible to apply for Medical Research Council (MRC) funding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligibility is tied to being based at an organisation that is eligible to receive MRC funding; the page lists this as a mandatory condition for the Experimental medicine stage one opportunity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invitation-only requirement (UKRI metascience scientometrics)
rubrics_metrics.description: You must be invited to apply for this funding opportunity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The UKRI metascience scientometrics for research assessment opportunity is explicitly invite-only; only invited applicants may submit proposals. (Publication date 28 April 2026; opening date 28 April 2026 9:00am UK time; closing date 2 June 2026 4:00pm UK time.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of work — metascience scientometrics
rubrics_metrics.description: Apply for funding to develop, validate, and critique novel scientometric indicators for use in research assessment and in metascience research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The opportunity specifies the thematic scope (novel scientometric indicators, validation and critique) and is targeted at metascience research and research-assessment tool development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding amount and full economic cost (FEC) coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: We expect to fund up to £3 million at 80% full economic cost (FEC).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This describes the expected total fund and the percentage of full economic cost covered (80% FEC) for the UKRI metascience scientometrics opportunity; the page also lists funders and co-funders (UKRI councils and DSIT).

rubrics_metrics.name: Opportunity timing and deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Each opportunity specifies opening and closing dates and times (e.g., opening date/time and closing date/time in UK time).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples on the page: Experimental medicine stage one — Opening: 30 April 2026 9:00am UK time; Closing: 7 October 2026 4:00pm UK time. UKRI metascience — Opening: 28 April 2026 9:00am UK time; Closing: 2 June 2026 4:00pm UK time. Applicants must submit within the stated windows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding type and funder/co-funder listing
rubrics_metrics.description: The page lists the funding type (Grant) and the named funders and co-funders for each opportunity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: Funders for the metascience opportunity include UK Research and Innovation and multiple research councils (ESRC, NERC, BBSRC, AHRC, STFC, EPSRC, MRC) with a co-funder listed (Department for Science, Innovation and Technology). Applicants should note the funder/co-funder mix as it may affect eligibility, scope, or reporting requirements.
